extracted.intended_audience: registrants (public companies) and their counsel/preparers responsible for Regulation S-K disclosures (mining issuers, bank/savings & loan registrants, and SPACs)
extracted.subtask_description: Prepare and evaluate required Regulation S-K disclosures for registrants, including mining property/mineral resource and reserve disclosures, internal controls, bank-specific financial disclosures, and SPAC prospectus/cover-page requirements. Covers content, format, timing, materiality, and supporting technical report requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Overview disclosure of mining properties material to investors
rubrics_metrics.description: When presenting the overview, the registrant should include the amount and type of disclosure concerning its mining properties that is material to an investor's understanding of the registrant's properties and mining operations in the aggregate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Disclosure will depend on the registrant's specific facts and circumstances and may vary; registrant should refer to, rather than duplicate, individually material property disclosure provided in response to §229.1304.

rubrics_metrics.name: Royalty-only registrant production disclosure (three years)
rubrics_metrics.description: A registrant with only a royalty or similar economic interest should provide only the portion of the production that led to royalty or other incomes for each of the three most recently completed fiscal years.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Limit production disclosure to the portion attributable to royalty/similar interest.

rubrics_metrics.name: Summary of all mineral resources and reserves at fiscal year-end
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a summary of all mineral resources and mineral reserves, as determined by the qualified person, at the end of the most recently completed fiscal year by commodity and geographic area and for each property containing 10% or more of the registrant's combined measured and indicated mineral resources or 10% or more of the registrant's mineral reserves, using the format in Table 1 (resources) and Table 2 (reserves).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Summary must be provided for each class of resources (inferred, indicated, measured) and reserves (probable, proven) together with totals; registrant may modify tabular formats for ease of presentation or to add information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Definition of 'by geographic area' for mineral disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: The term 'by geographic area' means by individual country, regions of a country, state, groups of states, mining district, or other political units, to the extent material to and necessary for an investor's understanding of a registrant's mining operations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Exclusivity of mineral resources disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: All disclosure of mineral resources by the registrant must be exclusive of mineral reserves.

rubrics_metrics.name: Disclosure only for registrant-attributable portion
rubrics_metrics.description: All disclosure of mineral resources and reserves must be only for the portion of the resources or reserves attributable to the registrant's interest in the property.

rubrics_metrics.name: Price basis and qualified person requirement for estimates
rubrics_metrics.description: Each mineral resource and reserve estimate must be based on a reasonable and justifiable price selected by a qualified person pursuant to §229.1302(d) or (e), which provides a reasonable basis for establishing the prospects of economic extraction for mineral resources, and is the expected price for mineral reserves.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Registrant must disclose the reasonable and justifiable price used, time frame and point of reference when estimating (Tables 1 and 2).

rubrics_metrics.name: Specific point of reference for estimates
rubrics_metrics.description: Each mineral resource and reserve estimate called for in Tables 1 and 2 must be based on a specific point of reference selected by a qualified person, and the registrant must disclose the selected point of reference for each of Tables 1 and 2.

rubrics_metrics.name: Currency of material assumptions for summary disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: All material assumptions and information pertaining to the summary disclosure of a registrant's mineral resources and mineral reserves required by this section, including material assumptions related to price estimates, must be current as of the end of the registrant's most recently completed fiscal year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If relying on previously filed report, that report must also be current in these material respects or a revised/new technical report summary must be filed per §229.601(b)(96).

rubrics_metrics.name: Use and disclosure of reasonable and justifiable price in Tables
rubrics_metrics.description: The registrant must use a reasonable and justifiable price for each commodity, which it must disclose, together with the time frame and point of reference used, when estimating mineral resources and mineral reserves for the Tables.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explicit requirement repeated for both Table 1 (resources) and Table 2 (reserves).

rubrics_metrics.name: Materiality determination for individual property disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: A registrant must disclose the information specified for each property that is material to its business or financial condition and, when determining materiality, must apply the standards and other considerations specified in §229.1301(c) to each individual property that it owns, operates (or is probable to operate), or has (or will have) an associated royalty or similar right.

rubrics_metrics.name: Royalty-holder lacking access to property information — permitted omissions
rubrics_metrics.description: A registrant that has a royalty, streaming or other similar right, but which lacks access to any of the information specified about the underlying property or properties, may omit such information provided it specifies the information to which it lacks access, explains why (unreasonable burden/expense or denied request), and provides all required information it does possess or can acquire without unreasonable burden or expense.

rubrics_metrics.name: Required brief description of each material property
rubrics_metrics.description: For each material property disclose a brief description including: location accurate to within one mile with appropriate, legible maps; existing infrastructure (roads, railroads, airports, towns, ports, sources of water, electricity, personnel); and brief description of titles/claims/concessions/leases/options (name/number, size/acreage), how rights are obtained and any conditions/expiration dates or payments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Maps must be legible on the page when printed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Royalty interest property disclosure content
rubrics_metrics.description: If the registrant holds a royalty or similar interest, the disclosure must describe all of the information required for property holders (documents under which owner/operator holds property, mineral rights held by owner/operator, conditions required of owner/operator, expiration dates), and briefly describe the agreement under which the registrant has the royalty including conditions and expiration.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Exception in §229.1304(a)(2) regarding lack of access still applies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Property condition, work completed, and current stage disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a brief description of the present condition of the property, the work completed by the registrant, proposed program of exploration or development, the current stage (exploration, development or production), and the current state of exploration or development and current production activities; identify mines as surface or underground with brief mining method and processing operations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If property lacks known reserves and program is exploratory or extraction commenced without reserves, the registrant must state that fact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Equipment, facilities, and infrastructure condition disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: Disclose the age, details as to modernization and physical condition of the equipment, facilities, infrastructure, and underground development.

rubrics_metrics.name: Property cost or book value disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: Disclose the total cost for or book value of the property and its associated plant and equipment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Previous operations history disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a brief history of previous operations, including the names of previous operators, insofar as known.

rubrics_metrics.name: Significant encumbrances and permitting disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a brief description of any significant encumbrances to the property, including current and future permitting requirements and associated timelines, permit conditions, and violations and fines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Exploration-stage property identification rule
rubrics_metrics.description: A registrant must identify an individual property with no mineral reserves as an exploration stage property, even if it has other properties in development or production; similarly, a registrant with no reserves on any of its properties cannot characterize itself as a development or production stage company.

rubrics_metrics.name: Limit regional geology in property disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: A registrant should not include extensive description of regional geology; rather, include geological information that is brief and relevant to property disclosure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tabular disclosure for individual property resources and reserves
rubrics_metrics.description: If mineral resources or reserves have been determined, the registrant must provide a summary for each property in tabular form (Tables for resources and reserves) showing estimated tonnages, grades/qualities, cut-off grades, and metallurgical recovery, based on a specific point of reference selected by a qualified person.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Registrant must disclose the selected point of reference for each table; registrant may modify tables for presentation but should not combine resources and reserves in the same table.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prohibition on reporting resources and reserves in same table
rubrics_metrics.description: When combining tables, the registrant should not report mineral resources and reserves in the same table.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Instruction 1 to paragraph (d)(1) — combining tables allowed for convenience but keep resources and reserves separate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Registrant with royalty interest resource/reserve proportion disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: A registrant with only a royalty or similar interest should provide only the portion of the resources or reserves that are subject to the royalty or similar agreement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comparison and explanation of year-over-year resource/reserve changes
rubrics_metrics.description: Compare the property's mineral resources and reserves as of the end of the last fiscal year with the preceding fiscal year and explain any material change, disclosing (1) resources/reserves at end of last two fiscal years; (2) net difference as percentage of preceding year's resources/reserves; (3) explanation of causes of discrepancies in mineral resources; and (4) explanation of causes of discrepancies in mineral reserves.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explanations should address causes such as depletion/production, changes in commodity prices, additional resources discovered, changes in methods employed, acquisition/disposal of properties, changes in resource model, and operating costs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Material assumptions and technical report summary filing when new or changed
rubrics_metrics.description: If the registrant has not previously disclosed reserve/resource estimates or is disclosing material changes to previously disclosed estimates, provide a brief discussion of the material assumptions and criteria and cite corresponding sections of the technical report summary, which must be filed as an exhibit pursuant to §229.1302(b).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All material assumptions must be current as of fiscal year-end; if relying on previously filed report that is not current, file revised or new technical report summary from a qualified person per §229.601(b)(96).

rubrics_metrics.name: Materiality standard for changes in resources/reserves
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether a change in mineral resources or mineral reserves is material is based on all facts and circumstances, both quantitative and qualitative.

rubrics_metrics.name: Exploration activity sampling summary requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: If disclosing exploration activity for any material property for the most recently completed fiscal year, provide a summary describing the sampling methods used, and for each sampling method disclose the number of samples, total size or length of the samples, and total number of assays.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Disclosure may be narrative or tabular.

rubrics_metrics.name: Exploration results disclosure requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: If disclosing exploration results for any material property for the most recently completed fiscal year, provide a summary that, for each property, identifies the hole, trench or other sample that generated the exploration results; describes the length, lithology, and key geologic properties of the exploration results; and includes a brief discussion of the exploration results' context and relevance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If only selected samples and intersections are included, accompany with discussion and justification for excluding other results; information may be narrative or tabular.

rubrics_metrics.name: Materiality test for exploration results
rubrics_metrics.description: A registrant must disclose exploration results and related exploration activity for a material property if they are material to investors; materiality should consider the importance of the exploration results in assessing value or in deciding whether to develop the property and the property's stage.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A change in exploration results that significantly alters the potential of the subject deposit is considered material; materiality is based on all facts and circumstances.

rubrics_metrics.name: Required detail when first disclosing exploration results or materially changing them
rubrics_metrics.description: If disclosing exploration results but not previously disclosed in a Commission filing, or disclosing material changes, provide sufficient information to allow accurate understanding of the significance: exploration context, type/method of sampling, sampling intervals/methods, relevant sample locations, distribution, dimensions, relative location of all relevant assay and physical data, data aggregation methods, land tenure status, and any additional material info; cite technical report summary sections if filing one.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prohibition on using pre-acquisition unverified estimates as current
rubrics_metrics.description: A report containing one or more estimates of quantity, grade, or metal/mineral content prepared before the registrant acquired (or entered into agreement to acquire) interest and not verified as current is not considered current and cannot be filed in support of disclosure, except in M&A filings when updating is impossible; in that event disclose source, date, and state that a qualified person has not classified the estimate as current.

rubrics_metrics.name: Internal controls disclosure for exploration and estimation (QC/QA)
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe the internal controls that the registrant uses in its exploration and mineral resource and reserve estimation efforts, including quality control and quality assurance (QC/QA) programs, verification of analytical procedures, and a discussion of comprehensive risk inherent in the estimation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Registrant must provide this disclosure whether providing disclosure under §229.1303, §229.1304, or both.

rubrics_metrics.name: Bank/savings & loan registrant coverage requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: A bank, bank holding company, savings and loan association, or savings and loan holding company must provide the disclosure required by Subpart 229.1400.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: General instruction applying Subpart 229.1400 to these registrants.

rubrics_metrics.name: Definition of reported period for bank disclosures
rubrics_metrics.description: When the term 'reported period' is used in this subpart it refers to (1) each annual period required by Regulation S-X or Form 1-A; and (2) any additional interim period subsequent to the most recent fiscal year end if a material change in information or trend has occurred.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of daily averages for bank reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: Registrants are required to use daily averages unless otherwise indicated; weekly or month-end averages may be used where daily averages would involve unwarranted or undue burden or expense, provided such averages are representative and the basis used for presenting averages is disclosed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Foreign activities disclosure threshold for banks
rubrics_metrics.description: Registrants must present foreign financial activities information only if they meet the threshold to make separate disclosures concerning foreign activities in consolidated financial statements pursuant to §210.9-05 of Regulation S-X.

rubrics_metrics.name: Average balance sheet presentation for banks
rubrics_metrics.description: For each reported period, present average balance sheets containing specified information; format may be condensed but must indicate significant categories of assets and liabilities including all major categories of interest-earning assets and interest-bearing liabilities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Major interest-earning asset categories include loans, taxable investment securities, non-taxable investment securities, interest-bearing deposits in other banks, federal funds sold, securities purchased with agreements to resell, and other short-term investments; major interest-bearing liability categories include savings deposits, other time deposits, federal funds purchased, securities sold under agreements to repurchase, commercial paper, other short-term debt, and long-term debt.

rubrics_metrics.name: Net interest earnings analysis requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: For each reported period present an analysis of net interest earnings including: (1) for each major category of interest-earning asset and each major category of interest-bearing liability, the average amount outstanding and the interest earned or paid; (2) average yield for each asset category; (3) average rate paid for each liability category; (4) average yield on all interest-earning assets and average rate on all interest-bearing liabilities; and (5) net yield on interest-earning assets (net interest earnings divided by total interest-earning assets).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Registrant may present analysis in connection with average balance sheet required by paragraph (a).

rubrics_metrics.name: Interest rates and interest differential analysis
rubrics_metrics.description: For each comparative reporting period present (1) dollar amount of change in interest income and interest expense; and (2) for each major category of interest-earning asset and interest-bearing liability, segregate changes into amounts attributable to changes in volume (change in volume × old rate), changes in rates (change in rate × old volume), and changes in rates and volume (change in rate × change in volume).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rates and volume variances must be allocated on a consistent basis between rates and volume variances, and the basis of allocation must be disclosed in a note to the table.

rubrics_metrics.name: Instructions for interest analysis (non-accruing loans, out-of-period items, fees, tax-equivalent basis)
rubrics_metrics.description: If material, disclose how non-accruing loans were treated; exclude out-of-period items and adjustments from calculation of changes and disclose types/amounts; disclose amount of material loan fees included in interest income; if tax-exempt income is on tax-equivalent basis, disclose extent and combined marginal or incremental rate used.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If foreign activities disclosure required, segregate domestic and foreign activities accordingly and present, on basis of averages, percentage of total assets and liabilities attributable to foreign activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Weighted average yields for debt securities by maturity buckets
rubrics_metrics.description: As of end of latest reported period state the weighted average yield of each category of debt securities not carried at fair value through earnings for which disclosure is required in the financial statements and is due in specified maturity buckets (in one year or less; after one year through five years; after five through ten years; after ten years).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Disclose how weighted average yield was calculated and whether tax-exempt yields computed on tax-equivalent basis; discuss major changes in tax-exempt portfolio.

rubrics_metrics.name: Loan portfolio maturity bucket disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: As of end of latest reported period, present separately the amount of loans in each category that are due in maturity buckets: in one year or less; after one year through five years; after five years through 15 years; and after 15 years.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For each loan category due after one year, present separately the total amount that have (1) predetermined interest rates and (2) floating or adjustable interest rates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Loan maturity classification instructions
rubrics_metrics.description: Report scheduled repayments in the maturity category in which the payment is due; report demand loans, loans having no stated schedule of repayments and no stated maturity, and overdrafts as due in one year or less; determinations of maturities shall be based upon contractual terms but include non-contractual rollovers/extensions where included for measuring allowance for credit losses under U.S. GAAP or IFRS and briefly discuss methodology.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Instruction guidance to Item 1404.

rubrics_metrics.name: Allowance for Credit Losses (ACL) ratios disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: For each reported period disclose the following credit ratios along with each component of the ratio's calculation: (1) ACL to total loans outstanding at each period end; (2) Nonaccrual loans to total loans outstanding at each period end; (3) ACL to nonaccrual loans at each period end; and (4) Net charge-offs during period to average loans outstanding during period (provide for each loan category).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide discussion of factors that drove material changes in these ratios or related components during the periods presented.

rubrics_metrics.name: Breakdown of ACL by loan category (allocation table)
rubrics_metrics.description: At the end of each reported period provide a breakdown of the allowance for credit losses by each loan category required by U.S. GAAP in the prescribed tabular format showing balance at end of period applicable to each loan category, amount, percent of loans in each category to total loans, and total 100%.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Instruction: foreign private issuers using IFRS do not need to provide some ratios; net charge-offs must be based on current period net charge-offs for each loan category.

rubrics_metrics.name: Deposit categories and averages disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: For each reported period present separately the average amount of and the average rate paid on each deposit category that exceeds 10% of average total deposits: noninterest bearing demand deposits; interest-bearing demand deposits; savings deposits; time deposits; and other.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Registrant may use other categories if more appropriate; present domestic and foreign separately if material; present aggregate amount of deposits by foreign depositors in domestic offices if material (no nationality required).

rubrics_metrics.name: Uninsured deposits disclosure and methodology
rubrics_metrics.description: As of the end of each reported period present separately the amount of uninsured deposits. For U.S. federally insured institutions uninsured deposits are portions exceeding FDIC limit or similar state limits and other uninsured investment/deposit accounts classified as deposits; foreign registrants must disclose definition appropriate for country of domicile. If precise measure not reasonably practicable, disclose that amounts are estimates and the methodologies/assumptions used.

rubrics_metrics.name: Time deposits uninsured and excess FDIC limit maturity breakdown
rubrics_metrics.description: As of the end of the latest reported period state the amount outstanding of (1) the portion of U.S. time deposits, by account, that are in excess of FDIC insurance limit or similar state regime; and (2) time deposits that are otherwise uninsured, by time remaining until maturity: 3 months or less; over 3 through 6 months; over 6 through 12 months; over 12 months.

rubrics_metrics.name: Definitions for SPAC-related terms
rubrics_metrics.description: Definitions for purposes of Subpart 229.1600: 'de-SPAC transaction' (business combination with target(s)); 'special purpose acquisition company (SPAC)' (company with indicated business plan to conduct an offering, complete business combination within timeframe, return proceeds if not completed, or represented SPAC strategy); 'SPAC sponsor' (entity/person primarily responsible for organizing/directing/managing SPAC business affairs excluding certain officers/directors); 'target company' (operating company, business or assets).

rubrics_metrics.name: SPAC forepart/cover page plain English disclosures
rubrics_metrics.description: In addition to Item 501, provide on the outside front cover page of the prospectus in plain English: (1) time frame for SPAC to consummate a de-SPAC transaction and whether extendable; (2) whether security holders will have opportunity to redeem and whether redemptions are subject to limitations; (3) amount of compensation received or to be received by SPAC sponsor, affiliates and promoters, amount of securities issued or to be issued to sponsor/affiliates/promoters and price, and whether this may result in material dilution, with cross-reference highlighted; and (4) tabular disclosure at quartile intervals based on percentages of the maximum redemption threshold showing offering price, net tangible book value per share as adjusted at assumed redemption levels, and difference between offering price and adjusted net tangible book value per share, with cross-references.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Instruction: if offering includes over-allotment option provide separate rows showing info with and without exercise of over-allotment.

rubrics_metrics.name: SPAC conflicts of interest disclosure on cover page
rubrics_metrics.description: State whether there may be actual or potential material conflicts of interest between the SPAC sponsor, its affiliates, or promoters, and purchasers in the offering, and provide a highlighted cross-reference to locations of related disclosures in the prospectus.

rubrics_metrics.name: SPAC prospectus summary plain English disclosures
rubrics_metrics.description: Prospectus summary must include brief plain-English descriptions of: (1) how the SPAC will identify and evaluate potential business combination candidates and whether it will solicit shareholder approval for the de-SPAC transaction; (2) material terms of the trust or escrow account and amount/percentage of gross offering proceeds to be placed therein; (3) material terms of the securities being offered including redemption rights and whether the securities are the same class as those held by the SPAC sponsor and affiliates; (4) period of time to consummate de-SPAC and plans if not completed including extensions and consequences; (5) any plans to seek additional financings and how those terms may impact unaffiliated security holders; and (6) tabular disclosure of sponsor/affiliate/promoter compensation and securities (nature and amount) and discussion of potential dilution.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide cross-references, highlighted by prominent type or other manner, to related disclosures in the prospectus.
